text:
sara: quick thought — can we consolidate the various sampling heuristics (smoke sampler, bench-prober, golden probe) into a single sampler abstraction? we're seeing duplicated logic + inconsistent seeds causing bench flakiness. want to propose a short refactor to a shared sampler descriptor (proto) and a small lib/service. thoughts?
mike: i like the idea. main concern is latency if we call a network service on the intake path. could we initially implement as a shared library distributed via our internal package registry and later offer a service?
jamal: we actually have 3 different implementations right now across repos. replay mismatches come from tokenization + seed handling. centralizing would help reproducibility a lot.
priya: for canary/eval determinism matters more than p95. for production live sampling we can keep an async/lightweight path. so maybe two modes: deterministic (for benches/canaries) and best-effort (for live traffic).
olga: agreed. also we need to bake provenance into the descriptor so benches can replay exact inputs. something like: 
```json
{
  "sampler_name": "stratified",
  "seed": "42",
  "strata": ["short","medium","long"],
  "weights": ["0.5","0.3","0.2"],
  "version": "v1"
}
```
kevin: add `tokenizer_hash` and `kv_cache_policy` fields — subtle tokenization changes or cache priming will silently change outputs. also include `sampling_timestamp` and `source_commit`.
sara: thanks — good catches. interface boundary question: intake -> sampler(descriptor) -> bench/prober. two options: A) central sampler service that returns descriptors; B) shared lib that generates descriptors in-proc. tradeoffs: service = central control + easier evolution; lib = zero-rpc latency and simpler rollout. i vote prototype the shared lib first.
jamal: prototype libs are faster. also we should add a tag `golden_input: true` so golden probes are always picked reproducibly. and a `smoke` boolean to let the prober skip heavy samples.
priya: rough effort: core lib + descriptor proto + bench runner hooks ~2 sprints; repo rollouts + infra + telemetry ~1 sprint. can we align with infra Q2 work?
ci-bot: action item: create feature-flag `sampler_consolidation` for staged rollout; ensure bench-e2e tests include seed/provenance checks.
mike: one more operational note — document how sampler interacts with KV prefix caching and warmed-up KV state. sampler should optionally record `kv_prefix_state` or at least the prewarm strategy used. otherwise latency/throughput benches will be inconsistent.
olga: we'll add `kv_policy` to the descriptor and surface it in bench telemetry. also plan a small replay harness to validate descriptor -> identical inputs across runs.
sara: next steps i propose: 1) priya draft `SampleDescriptor` proto and send RFC follow-up; 2) jamal prototype the shared lib + simple adapter in bench runner; 3) mike run staging canary with feature-flag; 4) olga add tokenizer_hash + kv_policy to bench telemetry. i'll file tickets and assign owners. anyone object?
jamal: no objections, sounds good.
kevin: ack, i'll review the proto once priya posts it.
ci-bot: reminder: please link any RFCs to infra-cadence board.
sara: thanks all — i'll open the RFC follow-up and ping infra + bench owners. :thumbsup:
